text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yaaawn… The weariness just won't go away. So many races in such a short span of time does take its toll.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: But of course, I do realize my destination lies at the end of this path.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: …No, pay that no mind. Please forget I said anything.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like Mejiro Bright's race fatigue is catching up with her. Maybe I'd better rearrange her race schedule.
